en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;I guess that makes them▼"nuclear" marshmallows and not▼"roasted" marshmallows, huh?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It does sound so much cooler▼though!
$024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Don't you think going back▼to school after the winter▼vacation is depressing?
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Hết nghỉ đông phải▼quay lại trường,▼buồn muốn xỉu nhỉ?

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;Personally, I can never relax▼fully when on vacation...
$024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;I'm worried about going back to▼school the whole time so I can't▼fully relax.
vi: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;Suốt kỳ nghỉ cứ lo▼ngày quay lại trường,▼thế thì nghỉ ngơi sao nổi!

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;They need to invent a way▼to vacation away from your▼vacation. Mmm...perfect.
vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Phải có kỳ nghỉ▼để... nghỉ sau kỳ nghỉ!▼Ôi, hoàn hảo!

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;You just gotta be careful. If▼you swing them in circles too▼hard, they might break on you.
vi: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;Nhưng phải cẩn thận!▼Vung mạnh thành vòng tròn▼là pháo gãy đấy!

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Sometimes even just tapping▼them with your finger will▼send sparks flying at you!
vi: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Có khi chỉ chạm nhẹ▼mà tia lửa đã▼bắn tóe vào tay rồi!

en: I guess it's important to be▼safe when you wanna look▼cool in front of your friends!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Summertime rocks! You get to▼eat nice, cold ice cream to▼cool yourself off!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Mùa hè thích quá!▼Được ăn kem lạnh▼để hạ nhiệt!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I heard that you can train▼yourself to get used to it so▼your head won't hurt anymore!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Nghe nói luyện ăn nhiều▼thì sẽ hết bị▼đau buốt đầu đấy!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Problem is, I've eaten so much▼that my stomach hurts. Do you▼know how to solve that problem?
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Khổ nỗi tớ ăn nhiều quá▼giờ đau cả bụng!▼Cậu biết chữa sao không?

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I got a friend who says he hates▼this season 'cause he gets "hay▼fever."

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;So I touched his forehead,▼but it didn't feel hot at all.
$024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Do you think he's just making▼stuff up so he can play hooky?
$024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;Waking up early gets harder▼as the days get colder.
$024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;It's hard to drag yourself▼out of that nice, warm bed▼just to go to school...
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Rời chiếc giường ấm ơi là ấm▼để tới trường...▼đúng là cực hình.

en: but you can't stay in there▼forever.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;You know why? It's just▼like the heroes always▼say in the movies...

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;More than anything though,▼when nature calls, it's best▼to go to the bathroom!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;At this time of year,▼you can sometimes find▼bears walking around!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;But then $503'318;▼begged me to tell the secret▼location, so I did.
